query:
SELECT (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM slot_start AT TIME ZONE $2)::int - 1) AS "weekday!",
                  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM slot_start AT TIME ZONE $2)::int AS "hour!"
           FROM bookings
           WHERE host_unid = $1 AND slot_start >= $3 AND status <> $4
           GROUP BY 1, 2
           ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, 1, 2
           LIMIT 1
